info.title: PowerTools Platform API
info.description:
Welcome to the PowerTools Platform API. This page describes all endpoints and expected parameters that are available.

- All date times are ISO 8601 and UTC unless otherwise noted.
- Rate limiting is implemented with a sliding window per user.
- Averaging more than 1 call per second over a small time period will result in 429 Too Many Requests responses.

[Static Documentation](https://tenaska.atlassian.net/wiki/external/YjFjNzRhMmZhMTA5NDY3MGEzOGI2OThkOWU0YzE0MGM)

/authentication/token.description: Responsible for generating a JWT to use with Bearer authentication.

/ptp/{market}/{endpoint}.description: Returns details about selected market's endpoint.
